guide.001: 📖 Aap guide kahan se shuru karna chahenge?
guide.003: ℹ️ Theek hai. Jab bhi zaroorat ho, "guide" likhein.
guide.004:
Customer ka message copy ya forward karein, ya khud likhein:
"{0}"
Baqi tafseel bot khud samajh kar order tayyar kar dega.
guide.005:
📖 Payments
Customer ko payment ki tafseel bhejne ke liye likhein: "payment link".
Payment mosool hone par likhein: "mark 4 paid".
Apna JazzCash / Easypaisa number darj karne ke liye likhein: "add payment: jazzcash, 0300-1234567".
guide.007:
📖 Step 2/4 — Orders Dekhna
Likhein: "orders today" ya "pending orders".
Orders ki list foran bhej di jayegi.
guide.008:
📖 Step 3/4 — Status Tabdeel Karna
Order rawana kar diya ho to likhein: "mark 1 shipped".
Delivery mukammal ho jaye to likhein: "mark 1 delivered".
guide.009:
📖 Step 4/4 — Madad
Kisi bhi waqt "menu" ya "guide" likhein, rehnumai dobara dastiyab hogi.
🎉 Aap tayyar hain — ab pehla order likh kar dekhein.
